channel.title: FSD by the numbers: changes
channel.description: Updates and corrections to Supercharged Daily's FSD by the numbers page.

item.title: Update, 28 Oct 2026
item.description: Added a 'When it updates next' table, a follow-by-email box, an RSS feed of this change log, a share image and a country picker in the markets section.

item.title: Update, 28 Oct 2026
item.description: Added the safety claims section (Tesla's published crash-rate comparisons, with what each is compared against) and the promises strip (all 15 FSD / autonomy entries in the ledger), which reads the same ledger as the promise tracker.

item.title: Update, 28 Oct 2026
item.description: Added the world map of Tesla-listed markets, the EU state tiles, the two FSD·EU thresholds (reported by FSD·EU, not an EU announcement), the recognition timeline and the population share, which is our own arithmetic on Eurostat's 1 January 2025 figures.

item.title: Update, 28 Oct 2026
item.description: Added the cumulative FSD miles chart (read from Tesla's deck chart, marked approximate), the Teslascope build charts (running totals of cars seen on each build, and new cars per day) and the FSD release timeline.

item.title: Update, 27 Oct 2026
item.description: Page created. Adoption figures are taken from Tesla's Q1, Q2 and Q3 2026 shareholder decks; countries come from our global FSD tracker data.
